Hi Sarah — thanks for the questions. Quick answers inline and attachments with more detail.

1) SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for the period ending Dec 31, 2027. The full report is available to share under NDA or via our secure document portal. Summary attached and link below.

2) BAA: We have a standard BAA template used for Dedicated and Private deployments. We can share a redlineable copy once you confirm you want to pursue Dedicated + BAA or Private + BAA. For most customers, Dedicated + BAA is sufficient when MedVera performs de-identification before sending any persistent PHI to Redwood. Private/on-prem is recommended if you cannot guarantee de-identification or require customer-managed networking.

3) KMS/HSM: Customer-managed KMS is supported in Dedicated and Private. For Dedicated we support AWS KMS CMKs (customer-managed). Private deployments support KMS integrations to your on-prem HSM via our connector; we also offer partner-based HSM integrations for higher-assurance needs. See attached kms_integration_notes.md for specifics and required config.

4) PHI pre-processing: De-id is a great approach. Two practical recommendations:
   - Strip or tokenise direct identifiers before sending. Tokenized references are much safer if you need context across sessions.
   - Limit context window retention; use short-lived KV cache for any state that contains identifiers.
   - Avoid sending whole clinical notes verbatim; consider extractive summarization on-prem and send summaries.

5) Audit logs & retention: Default request/response logs are retained 30 days in Hosted, configurable for Dedicated (30/90/365) and fully customer-controlled in Private. Logs are stored encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys when configured.

Attachments included: [Attachment: hipaa_deployment_matrix_v2.xlsx], [Attachment: kms_integration_notes.md]

Next steps we propose:
- Redwood: upload SOC 2 report to portal (NDA) + share BAA template (Grace).
- MedVera: return the completed vendor questionnaire and availability for a security kickoff call (security@medvera.com).

Happy to join the kickoff call with Alex for networking/KMS specifics.

Regards,
